plainLanguage: Sections 56 hadi 58 zimefutwa (repealed) katika Penal Code ya sasa.
meaning: The consolidated Code retains these numbers as a repeal marker rather than operative provisions.
keyPoints: R.E. 2022 attributes the repeal to Act No. 3 of 1976 s. 55.
Historical wording requires a separate authoritative source.

legalTerms.meaning: Provision imeondolewa na legislation na si operative substantive text ya current Code.

history.summary: R.E. 2022 records sections 56-58 as repealed by Act No. 3 of 1976 s. 55.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Digital library should preserve the exact current legislative status and avoid reconstructing unsupported law.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Application must follow the complete statutory wording and the law in force at the relevant time.
